verdict.rationale: Formant documents several first-party SDKs: an Agent SDK for ingesting telemetry, handling commands and teleoperation, and a Python Cloud SDK for querying and ingesting data. Its official GitHub toolkit adds a RealtimeSDK for building custom applications. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK quality, a published OpenAPI spec (probes returned 404), and evidence of language coverage and versioning beyond the Python Cloud SDK.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: The Agent SDK client contains a suite of methods which allow you to ingest telemetry data, receive and respond to commands, teleoperate your device, and more.
The primary programmatic way data scientists query for telemetry data is via the Cloud SDK, a lightweight Python module which can interact with the query API.
Create your own application that uses Formant's APIs and RealtimeSDK for data
Formant's APIs and SDKs which allow you to programmatically ingest data, configure devices, design custom views and modules
